response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong technical versatility and entrepreneurial experience, particularly with open-source projects and AI-adjacent work (e.g., AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq). While his background aligns well with software engineering and innovation, his lack of a formal AI/ML degree and limited explicit AI product leadership may require deeper exploration during an interview.
strengths: Diverse technical expertise across full-stack, embedded, and infrastructure engineering with 15+ years of experience.
Entrepreneurial mindset evidenced by founding GISCollective and open-source contributions.
Strong leadership in developer tooling and AI-adjacent workflows (e.g., MCP code generators at re:cinq).
concerns: No advanced degree in AI/ML or explicit focus on AI strategy in past roles.
Limited evidence of direct cloud platform leadership or large-scale AI product ownership.
German language skills are basic, which may impact collaboration in a Berlin-based team.
